payload.description: Unauthorized or non-owner update/delete negative partitions

designer_revisions.reason: Ensure explicit ownership/auth negative coverage for edit and delete branches.

payload.description: Post-delete list observability checks across relevant list queries

payload.title: Update attempt by unauthenticated or non-owner is rejected
steps: PUT /articles/{slug} without token or with token of a different author
payload.expected_result: Request is rejected and article state is unchanged

designer_revisions.reason: Strengthen explicit negative evidence for integrated R7.

payload.title: Delete attempt by unauthenticated or non-owner is rejected
steps: DELETE /articles/{slug} without token or with token of a different author
payload.expected_result: Request is rejected and article remains available to owner

designer_revisions.reason: Strengthen explicit negative evidence for integrated R10.

payload.title: Deleted article is absent from detail and list reads
steps: GET /articles with global and relevant filtered queries
payload.expected_result: Deleted article is not returned by detail or list endpoints

designer_revisions.reason: Add explicit list observability coverage required by integrated R12.
